rules.title: Prohibition Against Algorithmic Rent-Fixing in the Rental Housing Market
rules.requirement: Hoboken landlords may not use software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms that use nonpublic competitor information (under 365 days old) to coordinate, recommend or set rents, lease terms or occupancy levels. If you believe your landlord is doing this, you or the Division of Housing can bring a complaint in Hoboken Municipal Court.
rules.key_value: Fine up to $2,000 or up to 90 days community service

coverage.summary: All residential dwelling units (primary residences) in Hoboken, excluding medical/long-term care and detention facilities.

rules.exemptions: Medical/long-term care and detention facilities are excluded from the definition of residential dwelling unit.
rules.penalty: Upon conviction, one or more of: penalties under N.J.S.A. 40:49-5; a fine not exceeding $2,000; community service not exceeding 90 days. Enforced by the Division of Housing or any aggrieved private citizen in Hoboken Municipal Court.
rules.quoted_span: Landlords who rent any residential dwelling unit (defined as any primary residence excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities) in the City of Hoboken are prohibited from price fixing using algorithmic pricing.
rules.interaction: Ordinance adopted (final passage) July 9, 2025 and states it takes effect immediately upon passage and publication; under N.J.S.A. 40:69A-181(b) a NJ municipal ordinance takes effect 20 days after final passage, so effective date computed as 2025-07-29.
rules.conflict_note: Ordinance title adds new Section 158-2 to Chapter 158, but the body heading numbers the section § 154-8; codified section number should be verified.

notes: Single rule extracted from the adopted ordinance record. Effective date computed from final passage date (Jul 9, 2025) plus 20 days per N.J.S.A. 40:69A-181(b); publication date not given.
